title: GENDER DISPARITIES IN STACKOVERFLOW’S COMMUNITY-BASED QUESTION ANSWERING: A MATTER OF QUANTITY VERSUS QUALITY

bias_targets.methodology: Inferring user gender via the genderComputer tool, conducting statistical analysis of user engagement and recognition metrics (e.g., reputation, votes, activity levels), and using LLMs and human evaluators to blindly rank answer quality to compare against community-accepted answers, aiming to detect any preference for male-authored content over female-authored content.
